title: Maximum useful parallelism
description: Trusted coordination fills the eligible frontier; independent work runs concurrently while scarce resources and conflicting changes remain protected.

title: Build graph, not runtime feedback
description: 190 workflow implementations and 190 independent test-authoring tasks can progress concurrently once their interfaces are stable.

title: Security and deployment boundaries
description: Engineering workers never receive production credentials, management-network access, host sockets or authority to approve their own output.
